name: Kaunertal Glacier Concert
beschreibung: Experience an open-air concert on the Kaunertal Glacier at 3,000 meters above sea level! International DJs and live bands perform under the stars as the sun sets behind the glacier peaks. The breathtaking glacier lift takes guests to the highest event stage in Austria.
kurzbeschreibung: An outdoor concert on the Kaunertal Glacier—enjoying music at an altitude of 3,000 meters.
